bullets.text: In Poonamallee, a youth undergoing treatment at a drug rehabilitation center was allegedly murdered by staff, prompting the office to monitor the crackdown.

In Tiruttani, a farmer staged a protest at a grievances meeting over illegal cash collection for paddy sacks, which the district team must investigate.
In Ambattur, CapitaLand unveiled a new data centre with an investment of one thousand nine hundred forty crores, boosting regional AI infrastructure.
The Centre is preparing a new data centre policy amid growing electricity demand concerns, which the portfolio team should closely monitor.
Startup founder Tejas Sudarshan pitched two AI ideas on the Chennai Metro to PM Modi, highlighting local tech innovation for the portfolio team.
Central intelligence officers arrested a TVK functionary in a multi-crore methamphetamine smuggling case, creating a major political controversy.
Udhayanidhi Stalin questioned Chief Minister Vijay over rampant drug smuggling, escalating political tensions across the state.
